## Problem and change

What behavior does this implement or fix? Which module and owner are affected?

## Validation

State the commands run and actual outcomes. Include edge cases and one small example.

## Data structure and interface impact

Describe representation, invariants and complexity for DS changes. Identify changed
types, return values, CSV fields, scheduling keys or affected consumers.

## Completion

- [ ] Relevant tests and ./run.sh pass.
- [ ] No production STL substitute hides an unfinished custom structure.
- [ ] Documentation and contribution evidence reflect actual work.
- [ ] Another member reviewed behavior and shared-interface changes.
